versions.changelog:
Initial release – KeyAPI integration for Threads data analysis and search.

- Enables discovery and analysis of Threads users and content via KeyAPI REST API using official docs.
- Maps user goals to workflow scenarios for user profiles, posts, reposts, replies, post details, comments, and search across top/recent content and profiles.
- Provides detailed workflow and interaction rules for goal identification, scenario mapping, input collection, and authenticated execution.
- Includes helper scripts for authentication setup, docs search, and live API execution.
- Enforces strict use of documented endpoints and parameters; avoids platform web scraping.
